name: Dr. TVAM Convolution
aliases: Separable 3D Convolution with Gaussian Diffusion Kernels
definition: A separable 3D convolution method using Gaussian diffusion kernels, implemented via Dr.Jit's `dr.convolve` function for tomographic volumetric additive manufacturing simulations.
summary: Dr. TVAM Convolution is a separable 3D convolution using Gaussian diffusion kernels that reduces computational complexity for interactive tomographic volumetric additive manufacturing simulations.
